title: Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies
intro: These classic chocolate chip cookies are crispy on the edges, chewy in the center, and loaded with chocolate chips. Perfect for any occasion!
directions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Mix flour, baking soda, and salt in a bowl.
Beat butter and both sugars until creamy.
Add eggs and vanilla; beat well.
Gradually blend in flour mixture.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Drop rounded tablespoons onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake 9-11 minutes or until golden brown.
Cool on baking sheet for 2 minutes; remove to wire rack.
tips: For chewier cookies, slightly underbake them
Use room temperature butter for best results
Chill dough for 30 minutes for thicker cookies

title: Creamy Garlic Parmesan Pasta
intro: A rich and creamy pasta dish that comes together in under 20 minutes. Perfect for busy weeknights when you want restaurant-quality food at home.
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
directions: Cook pasta according to package directions; drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.
Add garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in heavy cream and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat and stir in Parmesan cheese until melted.
Season with salt and pepper.
Toss pasta in the sauce until well coated.
Garnish with parsley and red pepper flakes if desired.
tips: Use freshly grated Parmesan for best flavor
Don't let the sauce boil or it may separate
Add grilled chicken or shrimp for extra protein

title: Honey Glazed Salmon
intro: Perfectly cooked salmon with a sweet and savory honey glaze. This healthy dinner option is packed with omega-3s and takes just 20 minutes to make.
directions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Mix honey, soy sauce, lemon juice, garlic, and ginger in a bowl.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear salmon skin-side up for 3 minutes.
Flip salmon and brush with half the glaze.
Transfer skillet to oven and bake for 8-10 minutes.
Brush with remaining glaze halfway through.
Garnish with sesame seeds and green onions before serving.
tips: Don't overcook salmon - it should still be slightly pink in the center
Let salmon rest for 2-3 minutes before serving
Serve over rice or with roasted vegetables
